statics.purchase: Iseluleko sokuthenga: I-Afri-Star iwuhlobo olungadingi ukubanda okuningi olwakhiwe yi-ARC, olunesidingo esibhalwe esingu-300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit; izinsuku zalo zika-Disemba–Januwari zatholakala e-Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape futhi zidinga ukuqinisekiswa endaweni kwenye indawo. I-Granny Smith inereferensi yokuqala ukukha e-Elgin ngasekupheleni kuka-Mashi; i-SAPO ibala i-Golden Delicious noma i-Hillieri njengezinhlobo zempova ezihambisanayo. Lezi izinkomba zezinhlobo ezehlukene, akusona isikhathi esiqhubekayo sokukha noma isincomo se-KZN efudumele. Qinisekisa izitshalo ezitholakala enkulisa manje nokusebenza kwazo endaweni.

paragraphs.text: Ngaphambi kokuthenga, hlola uhlobo lwangempela, isiphunzi, ukubanda kwasebusika nomthombo wempova ohambisanayo. Ilebula lendawo yesimo sezulu efudumele noma ebandayo lodwa alikuqinisekisi lokhu.

Iseluleko sokuthenga: I-Afri-Star iwuhlobo olungadingi ukubanda okuningi olwakhiwe yi-ARC, olunesidingo esibhalwe esingu-300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit; izinsuku zalo zika-Disemba–Januwari zatholakala e-Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape futhi zidinga ukuqinisekiswa endaweni kwenye indawo. I-Granny Smith inereferensi yokuqala ukukha e-Elgin ngasekupheleni kuka-Mashi; i-SAPO ibala i-Golden Delicious noma i-Hillieri njengezinhlobo zempova ezihambisanayo. Lezi izinkomba zezinhlobo ezehlukene, akusona isikhathi esiqhubekayo sokukha noma isincomo se-KZN efudumele. Qinisekisa izitshalo ezitholakala enkulisa manje nokusebenza kwazo endaweni.
Hlanganisa ihlobo elifudumele nobusika obupholile obungenasithwathwa ukuze kuqhakaze; vikela emoyeni futhi unisele izitshalo ezisencane.

Iseluleko sokuthenga: Izinhlobo ezingacatshangelwa e-KZN: i-Fay Zee Siu yokuqala (maphakathi no-Novemba–maphakathi no-Disemba), i-Mauritius yaphakathi (maphakathi no-Novemba–ekuqaleni kuka-Januwari), i-Wai Chee yakamuva (ekupheleni kuka-Januwari–ekupheleni kuka-Februwari), ngokwezinkomba zezinhlobo ze-SALGA/ARC. Kgetha sebaka sa ho hola se nang le letsatsi se ntshang metsi hantle, sireletsa ho mela ha semela mme o rere ho faola bakeng sa kotulo ya mahlaku.

paragraphs.text: Pele o reka, hlahloba mofuta wa nnete, kutu ya motso, ho bata ha mariha le mohlodi wa peo o dumellanang. Leibole ya sebaka se futhumetseng kapa se batang feela ha e netefatse maemo ana.

Keletso ya ho reka: Afri-Star ke mofuta o hlahisitsweng ke ARC o hlokang ho bata ho fokolang, o nang le tlhoko e boletsweng ya 300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit; matsatsi a wona a Tshitwe–Pherekgong a fumanehile Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape mme a hloka ho hlahlojwa dibakeng tse ding. Granny Smith e na le tshupiso ya ho qala ho kga Elgin mafelong a Hlakubele; SAPO e bolela Golden Delicious kapa Hillieri e le balekane ba peo. Tsena ke ditshupiso tsa mefuta e arohaneng, ha se nako e tswelang pele ya ho kga kapa keletso bakeng sa KZN e futhumetseng. Netefatsa dimela tse fumanehang hajwale keretjheng le tshebetso ya lehae.
Nyalanya lehlabula le futhumetseng le mariha a phodileng a se nang leqhwa bakeng sa ho thunya; sireletsa moyeng mme o nosetse dimela tse nyane.

Keletso ya ho reka: Mefuta e ka nahanelwang KZN: Fay Zee Siu ya pele (bohareng ba Pundungwane–bohareng ba Tshitwe), Mauritius ya bohareng (bohareng ba Pundungwane–qalong ya Pherekgong), Wai Chee ya morao (mafelong a Pherekgong–mafelong a Hlakola), ho sebediswa ditshupiso tsa mefuta tsa SALGA/ARC. Netefatsa matsatsi a lehae, dimela tse fumanehang keretjheng le maemo a ho thunya.

paragraphs.text: Kambela gwitsi, ku huma ka mati ni khombo ya mavabyi hi nkarhi wa swiluva. Ku khumbeka hi ku hisa ni ku hisiwa hi dyambu swa hambana hi mixaka.

Switsundzuxo swo xava: ARC yi katsa Tommy Atkins na Kent eka mixaka leyi tiyiselaka ku hisa/ku hisiwa hi dyambu ku antswa; Sensation na Keitt swi khumbeka ngopfu. Tiyisisa masiku ya ntshovelo ya ndhawu u nga si hlawula mixaka leyi landzelelanaka.
Hlawula ndhawu yo kula leyi nga ni dyambu ni ku huma ka mati kahle, sirhelela ku sungula ku kula kutani u pulana ku thena leswaku ku tshoveriwa matluka.

Switsundzuxo swo xava: Tirhisa switirhisiwa swo byala swa ndhawu leswi tivekaka kahle. A ku na nxaxamelo wo koma wa mixaka leyi nga ni mavito leyi tiyisisiweke endhawini leyi nga ni xihlovo; pulani leyi a yi vuli leswaku ximilana xi khoma nitrogen kumbe xi ni ku tirha ka vutshunguri.

paragraphs.text: U nga si xava, kambela muxaka wa xiviri, nsinya wa timitsu, ku titimela ka xixika ni xihlovo xa mpova lexi fambisanaka na wona. Lebulu ya ndhawu ya maxelo yo kufumela kumbe yo titimela yi ri yoxe a yi tiyisisi swiyimo leswi.

Switsundzuxo swo xava: Afri-Star i muxaka lowu humesiweke hi ARC lowu lavaka ku titimela kutsongo, lowu nga ni xilaveko lexi vuriweke xa 300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit; masiku ya wona ya N'wendzamhala–Sunguti ma kumeke eBien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape naswona ma fanele ku kambisisiwa endhawini kunwana. Granny Smith yi ni xikombo xa ku sungula ku kha eElgin ekuheleni ka Nyenyankulu; SAPO yi vula Golden Delicious kumbe Hillieri ku va vanghana va mpova. Swikombo leswi i swa mixaka yo hambana, a hi nguva yo kha leyi nga heriki kumbe xitsundzuxo xa KZN yo kufumela. Tiyisisa swimilana leswi nga kona sweswi endhawini yo kurisela ni ndlela leyi swi tirhaka ha yona endhawini.
Fananisa ximumu xo kufumela ni xixika xo titimela lexi nga riki na gwitsi leswaku ku ta huma swiluva; sirhelela eka moya naswona u cheleta swimilana leswitsongo.

Switsundzuxo swo xava: Mixaka leyi nga kambisisiwaka eKZN: Fay Zee Siu yo sungula (exikarhini ka Hukuri–exikarhini ka N'wendzamhala), Mauritius ya le xikarhini (exikarhini ka Hukuri–eku sunguleni ka Sunguti), Wai Chee ya le ndzhaku (ekuheleni ka Sunguti–ekuheleni ka Nyenyenyani), hi ku tirhisa swikombo swa mixaka swa SALGA/ARC. Tiyisisa masiku ya ndhawu, swimilana leswi kumekaka endhawini yo kurisela ni swiyimo swa ku huma ka swiluva.

paragraphs.text: Musi ni sa athu renga, ṱolani lushaka lwa vhukuma, mudzi wa mutheo, u rothola ha vhuriha na tshiko tsha luvhanda tshi tshimbidzanaho nalwo. Ḽebuḽu ya dzingu ḽi dudelaho kana ḽi rotholelaho i yoṱhe a i khwaṱhisedzi nyimele idzi.

Nyeletshedzo ya u renga: Afri-Star ndi lushaka lwo bveledzwaho nga ARC lu ṱoḓaho u rothola huṱuku, lu re na ṱhoḓea yo bulwaho ya 300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit; maḓuvha alwo a Nyendavhusiku–Phando o wanala Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape nahone a ṱoḓa u sedzulusiwa huṅwe henefho. Granny Smith i na tshiko tsha u thoma u ka Elgin mafheloni a Ṱhafamuhwe; SAPO i bula Golden Delicious kana Hillieri sa tshaka dzi ṋeaho luvhanda. Izwi ndi zwiko zwa tshaka dzo fhambanaho, a si tshifhinga tsha u ka tshi sa khauwi kana themendelo ya KZN i dudelaho. Khwaṱhisedzani zwimela zwi re hone zwino kha hune zwa alusiwa na kushumele kwa henefho.
Fhambanyisani tshilimo tshi dudelaho na vhuriha vhu rotholelaho vhu si na ṅwando uri hu vhe na maluvha; tsireledzani kha muya ni sheledze zwimela zwiṱuku.

Nyeletshedzo ya u renga: Tshaka dzi nga sedzuluswaho kha KZN: Fay Zee Siu ya u thoma (vhukati ha Ḽara–vhukati ha Nyendavhusiku), Mauritius ya vhukati (vhukati ha Ḽara–mathomoni a Phando), Wai Chee ya murahu (mafheloni a Phando–mafheloni a Luhuhi), hu tshi shumiswa zwiko zwa tshaka zwa SALGA/ARC. Khwaṱhisedzani maḓuvha a henefho, zwimela zwi re hone hune zwa alusiwa na nyimele dza maluvha.
